scope: Fresh prostate tissues (~60 mg) stored in RNAlater for improved stability were washed in 80% (v/v) cold acetonitrile (ACN) and resuspended in an extraction buffer containing 8 M urea, 10 mM DTT, 1 mM sodium fluoride, 1 mM sodium orthovanadate, and a protease inhibitor cocktail (1:10).
Prostate tissues were rapidly lysed (2 min, 30 Hz with a 5 mm stainless steel bead) using a TissueLyser (Qiagen).
Proteins (500 μg) were reduced using 10 mM DTT, 30 min, 30 °C, and alkylated using 40 mM iodoacetamide
